ai.literal: Possessing love, noble lineage being born, king desiring possessing good qualities: message he who speaks quality.
ai.translation: Possessing love, being born in a noble lineage, and having the good qualities desired by kings are the true characteristics of an envoy.
ai.modern: அன்பு கொண்டிருத்தல், சிறந்த குடியில் பிறந்திருத்தல், அரசர்கள் விரும்பும் நல்ல பண்புகளைப் பெற்றிருத்தல் ஆகியவையே தூது உரைப்பவனின் இலக்கணம் ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the three essential qualifications for an envoy or ambassador. First, they must possess genuine love and loyalty to their sovereign. Second, they should come from a noble and respected lineage, which ensures honorable conduct. Finally, they must have the refined qualities and culture that kings expect and appreciate in a diplomat.

ai.literal: Affection, knowledge, examined word-skill: to those who deliver a message, without (these) not forming, (are these) three.
ai.translation: Affection, knowledge, and well-considered eloquence are the three indispensable qualities for those who deliver an embassy's message.
ai.modern: அன்பு, அறிவு, ஆராய்ந்து பேசும் சொல்வன்மை ஆகிய மூன்றும் தூது உரைப்பவர்களுக்கு இன்றியமையாத பண்புகளாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the three essential qualities required of an envoy. First is affection or loyalty towards their own king, ensuring they act in the state's best interest. Second is knowledge, which allows them to understand complex political situations. Third is well-considered eloquence, the ability to choose the right words after careful thought. Together, these three are described as indispensable for anyone entrusted with delivering a diplomatic message.

ai.literal: Among the learned, treatise-expert being; among spearmen, victory-mission he-who-speaks' quality.
ai.translation: The defining quality of an envoy who successfully delivers his mission among spear-bearing kings is to be the foremost expert in statecraft among the learned.
ai.modern: வேல் ஏந்திய அரசர்களின் அவையில் சென்று வெற்றிகரமாகத் தன் தூதுச் செய்தியை உரைப்பவனின் பண்பு, நூல்களைக் கற்ற அறிஞர்களுக்கு இடையே தானும் சிறந்த நூல் வல்லவனாக விளங்குவதாகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the intellectual caliber required of an envoy. The word 'நூலாருள்' refers to assemblies of highly educated scholars, while 'வேலாருள்' refers to the courts of rival, heavily armed kings. To successfully deliver a message ('வென்றி வினை உரைப்பான்') in a hostile or intimidating royal court, the envoy must possess unshakeable confidence. This confidence comes from being an absolute expert in treatises of statecraft ('நூல் வல்லன் ஆகுதல்'), allowing him to outshine even the most learned scholars.

ai.literal: Intelligence, appearance, well-examined learning: of these three, fullness he who possesses, let him go to the task.
ai.translation: Let the man who possesses the fullness of these three traits—intelligence, a commanding appearance, and deeply researched learning—go forth on the mission.
ai.modern: இயற்கையான அறிவு, நல்ல தோற்றம், ஆராய்ந்து கற்ற கல்வி ஆகிய இம்மூன்றின் நிறைவையும் உடையவனே தூதுப் பணிக்குச் செல்ல வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualifications for an envoy sent on a diplomatic mission. The word 'அறிவு' (intelligence) refers to natural sharpness of mind, while 'உரு' (appearance) indicates a commanding and respectable physical presence. 'ஆராய்ந்த கல்வி' (well-examined learning) emphasizes that the envoy's education must be deep and thoroughly analyzed, not superficial. Only a person who possesses the 'செறிவு' (fullness or dense combination) of all three traits is fit to be dispatched for a state task ('வினை').

ai.literal: To summarize having spoken, displeasing things having removed, to smile having spoken, benefit that which yields is an envoy.
ai.translation: A true envoy speaks concisely, avoids displeasing words, speaks to bring a smile, and thereby yields a beneficial outcome.
ai.modern: சுருக்கமாகச் சொல்ல வேண்டியதைச் சொல்லி, வெறுப்பூட்டும் சொற்களை நீக்கி, கேட்பவர் மகிழும்படி பேசி, நன்மையை உருவாக்குபவரே சிறந்த தூதுவர் ஆவார்.
ai.explanation: This couplet outlines the communication strategy of a successful envoy. First, they must speak concisely ('தொகச் சொல்லி') so the core message is clear and impactful. Second, they must filter out any harsh or useless words ('தூவாத நீக்கி') that might offend the listener. Finally, they must deliver the message in a pleasant way that brings a smile ('நகச்சொல்லி'), ensuring that the diplomatic mission yields a beneficial result ('நன்றி பயப்பது').

ai.literal: Having learned, presence fearing not, to be accepted having spoken, by the time that which is fit knowing, is the envoy.
ai.translation: An envoy is one who has learned well, does not fear the presence of others, speaks persuasively, and knows what is appropriate for the time.
ai.modern: நூல்களைக் கற்று, பகைவர் அவைக்கு அஞ்சாமல், அவர்கள் ஏற்குமாறு பேசி, காலத்திற்கு ஏற்ற செயலை அறிபவரே சிறந்த தூதுவர் ஆவார்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential qualities of a successful envoy. They must be well-educated and fearless when standing in the presence of rival rulers. Furthermore, they must speak persuasively so that their message is accepted, while always knowing the most fitting action to take based on the current time and circumstances.

ai.explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of the best envoy or ambassador. The word 'தலை' literally means head, but here it takes the accepted sense of chief or the best. To achieve this rank, the envoy must first understand their duty. Then, they must carefully evaluate the time and place before speaking with thorough deliberation.

Along with these three (இம்மூன்றின்), unfailing truthfulness (வாய்மை) completes the nature (பண்பு) of a perfect ambassador.

ai.literal: Sent message to kings he who speaks, flaw word mouth not-joining courageous-man.
ai.translation: The envoy who delivers a dispatched message to foreign kings is a courageous man whose mouth never utters a flawed word.
ai.modern: அனுப்பப்பட்ட செய்தியை வேற்று அரசர்களிடம் சொல்பவன், தன் வாயில் குற்றமான சொற்கள் சேராதபடி பேசும் தைரியம் கொண்டவன் ஆவான்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the essential courage and discipline of an envoy. The phrase 'viṭumāṟṟam' refers to the message dispatched by his own king, which he must deliver to foreign or enemy kings. To do this without fear requires a 'vaṉkaṇavaṉ', a man of immense courage. Furthermore, his bravery is matched by his flawless speech, as his mouth never lets slip a flawed or disgraceful word.

ai.literal: Destruction even if it yields, without failing, to the king benefit that which yields is an envoy.
ai.translation: A true envoy is one who secures benefit for his king without faltering, even if it brings destruction upon himself.
ai.modern: தனக்கு அழிவே வந்தாலும், சிறிதும் தயங்காமல் தன் அரசனுக்கு நன்மையைத் தேடித்தருபவரே சிறந்த தூதுவர் ஆவார்.
ai.explanation: This couplet defines the ultimate loyalty and courage required of an envoy. The word 'இறுதி' (destruction or death) highlights the extreme danger an envoy might face in a hostile court. 'எஞ்சாது' means without shrinking back or failing in duty. Even when facing personal ruin, a true envoy ('தூது') ensures that his actions and words yield ('பயப்பது') only benefit ('உறுதி') to his king ('இறைவற்கு').
